Name: Bog's Mannequins

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wvc0ZXQj/retro-bookcase-21.png[/img]

I saw a great video on tiktok of someone setting up a closet of mannequins with different outfits to quick switch their clothes! I loved the idea so much hyperfixation took over and ﻿TADAAAAAA Bog's Mannequins were born! I also thought there was a big need for some more skintones as well. 

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods]my other mods[/url] as i have been working hard to turn the entire game into my aesthetic!!!

If you would like to see updates on my mods or get notified when a mod is published join my [url=https://discord.gg/tCpM2s2wa4]Discord Server[/url]﻿
We have a great community of mod authors who are making mods as well for the goblins, witches, forest folk & ghouls. 

All my [url=https://linktr.ee/BogWytch]Social Links[/url]﻿ <---

Again thank you so much for everything. I have been blown away by all your support.
<3
